quest.title: Encounters Always Happen on a Holiday
quest.description: While strolling around the Easybreeze Holiday Resort, you and Paimon spot some familiar figures...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000, Gift Egg Gifted by Capybara King x1

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look, there are people over there!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Huh, they look familiar. I think that's...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ororon and Ifa!

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: #Oh, {M#Gramps}{F#other Granny} and Paimon! I knew those were voices I recognized!

dialogues.speaker: Cacucu
dialogues.text: Bros! Bros!

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Hah! You're here at the resort, too! Man, it's been a while!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yep! Chasca told us you've been working here. Guess we were bound to run into each other at some point!

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Yeah, for sure. Yo, this place has a nice vibe to it, don't you think? I hear everyone's been having a blast.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, definitely! With any luck, it'll only get better, and we'll get even more visitors!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What about you two? How's your work going?

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Not bad! The saurian staff and the aphids are all in good health and full of energy, so we had some free time on our hands. Thought we'd take a look around.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: ...Aphid STAFF.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: The aphids are part of the staff, too. You missed that part.

dialogues.speaker: Cacucu
dialogues.text: You can say that again, bro!

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Right... My bad. I'm grateful to our entire staff, of course. And, to Mr. Ororon, for looking out for them so... proactively.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: We got here early to fight for an important cause. That's its own reward.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: You see, this is my bro's first time getting a formal invitation like that, and as you can probably tell, he's very, um... committed.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Enthusiasm's a good thing.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: #See? {M#Gramps}{F#Other Granny} knows what {M#he's}{F#she's} talking about.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Every day, we get a new chance to fight for what's important. Cacucu taught me that.

dialogues.speaker: Cacucu
dialogues.text: Haha!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But, aren't you just... fishing? Since when did that count as "fighting for what's important"?

dialogues.speaker: Cacucu
dialogues.text: Do you even hear yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Since it was suggested by a friend, of course. He's a famous adventurer from Mondstadt with incredible luck. If he says it'll work, who are we to argue?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Wait... Bennett?)

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Yeah, that bro spun a stick around and it ended up pointing at this pond. As Ororon put it — better to follow luck where it leads than try to make your own. So, we came to fish here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, even if that made sense... This pond is surrounded by capybaras! Can you even fish here?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Of course! Capybaras are gentle creatures, so we're good. Besides, when life gives you water, you fish. That's what Granny taught me.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Ah, another one of Granny's pearls of wisdom. Along with, "when life gives you food, you eat" or "when life gives you lemons, make lemonade."

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: #Haha, exactly. Except, we're the ones handing you lemons this time, {M#Gramps}{F#other Granny} and Paimon. Since you're here, why don't you fish with us?

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: And, to up the ante a bit... Whoever catches the biggest fish gets a pint of Ororon's Aphimead.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now that's an offer Paimon can get behind!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hehehe, did you forget who you're dealing with here? We never back away from a challenge, and {NICKNAME} is a tough opponent!

response.speaker: Ifa
response.text: Got your game face on, I see! Alright, I'm down!

response.speaker: Ororon
response.text: Alright, then it's winner takes all — meaning not only all the fish, but the aphid staff's mead too.

talks.objective: Partake in a thrilling fishing contest

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: #As the elder, you should go first, {M#Gramps}{F#other Granny}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Happily.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Wow, the competition's really heating up! Here comes a pro move from {NICKNAME}... and there's a bite! {NICKNAME} reels it in, and up comes a...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hold on... is that... an Asha?

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Wow... Not exactly the kind of catch I was expecting! Not super sure how we're gonna judge that...

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: #Nice one, {M#Gramps}{F#other Granny}! We'll have to see if anyone manages to reel in something even more special. Otherwise, that might be enough for the win.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks, everyone! I'm up against some fierce competition, but I think I've got a shot. Let's hope my grandson is right!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Quite the impressive showing from {NICKNAME}! That'll be a tough act for the remaining two competitors to follow!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ifa, you're up!

dialogues.speaker: Cacucu
dialogues.text: You've got this, bro! Teamwork makes the dream work!

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Sorry, Cacucu. There's no room for teamwork here.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Whoa, look alive, bros... I've got something!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Ifa reels in the rod with all his strength. Looks like he's caught something big...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: But... it's another unexpected catch.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: #As the elder, you should go first, {M#Gramps}{F#other Granny}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Happily.
